description: On the table in front of you there’s a small white lamp base with a square top plate, and a white bulb lying off to the right against a red backdrop. The left hand stays near the base to steady it while the right hand reaches right to grasp the bulb as a right-hand object, lifts it up and over the square mount, then lowers and seats it onto the top; the right hand makes a small adjusting twist and releases while the left hand continues to hold the base steady.
